ERR_STREAM_SYSTEM.message: Stream {stream} belongs to the board and cannot be removed

ERR_STREAM_TARGETS_FULL.message: Stream {stream} has no room for another connection or subscriber

ERR_STREAM_TOO_LONG.message: {len} bytes are too long for stream {stream} (at most {max})

ERR_STREAM_QUEUE_FULL.message: Stream {stream} is sending faster than its connections carry: {len} bytes dropped

ERR_STREAM_FULL.message: No room for stream {stream}: every slot is taken

ERR_STREAM_DIRECTION.message: Stream {stream} only takes what comes in: the board does not send to it
ERR_STREAM_DIRECTION.hint: Send to a stream made to go out.
